notes: Entry two: the wrong answer, said out loud, and the call that gets
answered.
Two things this tape has to carry, and both are load-bearing outside
the fiction:
* **"We can still transport."** This is where every survivor the
player rescues actually goes. `ROADMAP2.md` 1.7 decided the first
rescue does not need to put the ensign aboard the shuttle -- "a
safe off-screen recovery avoids creating a second persistent
person object" -- and that decision was mechanics looking for a
reason. Now it has one: there is a ship overhead that cannot move
and can still catch a transporter beam.
* **Why Shepard is on the ground and not up there.** She is the only
person in the detachment who spent six months learning how these
people boil water, and on the twelfth of July that stopped being
an academic interest. It also explains why the player inherits a
shuttle rather than a derelict: she chose to stay and use it.
The Section 31 accusation is made **outright** here, early, and with
her own admission that she has no evidence -- "a shape, and the shape
fits". That is what keeps the misdirection honest: she is reasoning
from a real Federation precedent, she says so, and she is wrong.
title: Personal Log -- Entry Two
subtitle: Lt. Lucy Shepard, cultural survey, U.S.S. Adirondack
author: recorded aboard this shuttle

lines.text: PERSONAL LOG -- ENTRY TWO
DAY NINETEEN -- TWENTY-SEVEN FEBRUARY
Nineteen days. Talking to myself for nineteen days.
Today somebody answered. I will get to that.
-- WHAT I THINK THIS IS --
I want this on record before anyone talks me out of it.
A hidden outpost. No relay. Nothing filed with anyone.
A world nobody has declared, above nobody's jurisdiction.
And then somebody quietly took our engines and our array.
From the inside. Without hurting a single person.
That is not an attack. That is somebody closing a door.
I have read the Dominion War files. The parts left in.
Section 31 has done worse than this, and done it to us.
So I will say it plainly. I think this is Section 31.
I have no evidence. I have a shape, and the shape fits.
She says the name like somebody testing a door.
-- THE ADIRONDACK --
I have called every six hours since the ninth.
Today the carrier came back. Thin, but it came back.
--epeat. Adirondack actual. Shepard, is that you?
I did not say anything for about four seconds.
We are intact. Hull is sound. Everyone aboard is fed.
We are not going anywhere. Warp is gone. Impulse too.
She is a very expensive orbital platform now.
We can still transport. That is the one thing we kept.
Write that down, whoever you are. They can transport.
Anyone you get onto clear ground can go up. Anyone.
-- THE PLAN --
Lucy. Come up. That is a request, not an order.
No thanks. I can do more down here.
Up there is a corridor, a mess hall and a viewport.
Down here is an intact pre-contact culture, mid-century.
Nobody is coming for years. That is years of fieldwork.
I am not going to spend them in a corridor.
And I am the only one of us who can pass for a local.
Six months of learning how these people live will do that.
So I stay. Ten others stayed. For the work.
-- ENTRY TWO ENDS --
Nineteen days, and somebody answered. Good day.
I am going to go and be useful.
